what: blaze-engine was cut to the `blaze` program at 05:57 (see /tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-integrate-engine.md section 3). as_rustc.rs is now named by no `mod` (the old lib it called, check.rs, `crate::answers`, `crate::cargo`, is gone), so it is yours to finish as a staged file. Until your port lands, program.rs's `stood_in_for()` makes a process started as `rustc`/`rustdoc` fail with an error naming the command. When your port compiles, you may make these exact edits yourself: add `mod as_rustc;` to crates/blaze-engine/src/lib.rs; in program.rs replace the `if let Some(tool) = stood_in_for() { return failed(...) }` block with your dispatch (`as_rustc::is_me()`/`command()`, and rustdoc's), deleting `stood_in_for` if unused; add the dependencies your port needs to crates/blaze-engine/Cargo.toml (workspace = true) and to blaze-engine's dependency list in Cargo.lock, then run the manifest lint. Paths: what was `crate::answers`/`crate::cargo::...` is `blaze_cargo::answers`/... now. Also from integrate-ide (00984): `known_feature` read `ide_db::generated::lints::FEATURES`; ide-db is being deleted and is no longer a blaze-engine dependency: answer it from blaze-diagnostics' language feature table (`lints/syntax/attrs/features/table.rs`, pub(crate) today: ask lane diagnostics to make it pub) and the loaded std's library features (`checks/features/library.rs`), keeping the test `probes_read`.
